richiami.difetto: Fuel hose may not be to correct specification.
richiami.rimedio: Check and if necessary replace the affected fuel hose.
richiami.titolo: FUEL HOSE COULD PERISH OVER TIME

richiami.difetto: Incorrect specification of steering wheel rivets.
richiami.modello: MOUNTNEY STEERING WHEEL , MOUNTNEY STEERING WHEEL
richiami.titolo: STEERING WHEEL RIVET CHANGE FROM ALUMINIUM TO STEEL

richiami.difetto: The pad abutment plate securing screw may come loose. This can cause scoring of the brake disc surface face. If ignored it is thought possible the plate could stop the front wheel from turning and increase the risk of collision.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the callipers that are likely to be affected. A new bolt with locking compound applied on assembly will be used.
